scripts.build:app: cd app && npx expo export -p web --output-dir dist
scripts.dev: npm run seed && wrangler d1 migrations apply testwise --local && wrangler d1 execute testwise --local --file seed/seed.sql && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build:app && npm run seed && wrangler d1 migrations apply testwise --remote && wrangler d1 execute testwise --remote --file seed/seed.sql && wrangler deploy
